user: And I still have time to file, right?
answer:
Probably, but it depends on the reason code. Dispute windows run from the transaction date, which for TX-0401 is 2026-07-20. Today's date in our system is 2026-09-15, which is 57 days after that. Measured from that date:

| Reason code | Window | Days left for TX-0401 |
|---|---|---|
| duplicate_charge | 60 days | 3 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 days | Closed (ended 1 day ago) |
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 days | 63 |
| goods_not_received | 90 days | 33 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 days | 33 |

If the issue is an unauthorized debit, the window has already closed, so that code isn't available for this payment. For a duplicate charge, you have 3 days left. TX-0402 (2026-07-14) is 63 days old, so its duplicate_charge window has already closed.

These are the windows from the knowledge base, and I haven't run an eligibility check yet. The check will confirm whether a dispute can be opened.

Which situation applies? If it's a duplicate charge, tell me soon, because that window closes in 3 days.
